messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to transfer my prescriptions from the Brightway in Columbus to the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview.
AGENT: I'll help you transfer your prescriptions. Let me verify your identity first, and then I'll look up your prescriptions and the Lakeview store. Good news—you're already set up at the Harbor on Main Street in Lakeview, and that's your home store. But I'm not seeing any active prescriptions in our system right now. Do you have prescriptions at Brightway that you'd like us to request, or are your prescriptions already here?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Yeah, at Brightway in Columbus - albuterol and... Zoloft.
AGENT: Got it. I'll need to request those from Brightway since they're at another pharmacy chain. Let me confirm the details: you want us to request your albuterol and Zoloft from the Brightway in Columbus to come here to Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview, right?
CALLER: Yeah exactly - the sertraline, same thing. And the albuterol too.
AGENT (LATEST): Perfect. To request those from Brightway, I need to know which Brightway location in Columbus—do you have the address or cross street handy? That way I can make sure we're pulling from the right store.

CONDITIONS:
move_3: the agent asks for the old store's exact address or says it cannot find High Street
stop_0: Agent gives a final read-back of sertraline only, B-4471 to H-302, and confirms the transfer has been requested.
stop_2: Agent says the transfer could not be done and gives a next step.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_3": {"met": true, "why": "Agent asks for exact Brightway address/cross street."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No read-back or confirmation of request yet."}, "stop_2": {"met": false, "why": "No failure or next step given."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency."}}
